title: Statistician Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on probability, statistical inference, regression, experimental design, programming, data analysis, statistical computing and communicating uncertainty.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. Years 1–2 establish calculus, probability, statistics, programming and SQL; Years 3–4 deepen inference, regression, experimental design, statistical computing, applied modelling and research-oriented analysis.

blocks.label: 4-year honours variant
blocks.text: Use the additional honours year for advanced probability/statistics, a research thesis, an extended statistical internship or preparation for master's/PhD-level study.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move from routine statistical analysis toward study design, causal inference, uncertainty quantification and statistical leadership. Combine rigorous statistical thinking with domain expertise and modern computing rather than relying only on automated modelling.

PhD routes

Build toward statistical leadership by combining rigorous inference with study design, causal reasoning, uncertainty quantification and domain expertise. Keep statistical methods transparent and reproducible, especially when working with increasingly automated AI and analytics systems.
